claims.text: An Enum member is a VALUE, not a typed field: parse.py forces its annotation to "" precisely so no member->type edge can be fabricated for it, and ``emit`` will count it as missing.
claims.why: The claim about parse.py behavior is not verifiable from this chunk; the code here does emit a site with raw=decl.annotation which would be empty string if parse.py does that.

claims.text: the implicit self/cls, never a param
claims.why: The code explicitly skips parameters where position==0 and param.name==sig.receiver, which matches the claim.

claims.text: Told us nothing: the whole match set is dropped rather than truncated, because the first N of an arbitrary set is a guess.
claims.why: The code uses 'continue' to skip adding any matches when len(matches) > STRUCTURAL_MAX_MATCHES, exactly as claimed.

observations.what: Enum member processing emits a site with raw=decl.annotation and attributes; comment claims annotation is forced to empty by parse.py.
Function signature processing skips self/cls parameter if position==0 and name matches receiver.
Structural protocol matching uses frozenset containment (wanted <= members[node_id]) to find matches.
Hub cap suppression removes edges targeting nodes in hub_set from _CAPPED_RELATIONS; fan_in keyed by target stores set of 'relation:function_ref' strings.
After hub suppression, edges for all RELATIONS are sorted by _edge_key.
